additional_info.subject: Notes for NOC / TS
additional_info.body:
Charger is out of warranty
Check with RC-FR (Jessica), most likely there is an extended warranty for Engie chargers
Check DC 1, Pt100 temp reading from AWS for last 2 Weeks
Attach you finding in case timeline.
Discuss internally with RC France, if they want to replace the cable, because heating of contact seems to be from Vehicle, not sure if it is a cable defect
